_comment: Fills in nodes the adversarial review found missing. build.js reads every *.json in the data directory, so added nodes go in this file (patches.js can only amend nodes that already exist).

nodes.label: Turn the status into a description
nodes.detail: Turns the overallStatus number into the fixed RSS wording: -1 = No Services, all UP = All Systems Operational, mixed = Partially Degraded, all DOWN = Degraded, maintenance = Under maintenance

nodes.label: Visitor's browser
nodes.detail: Whoever opens the root of the custom domain. The DNS CNAME is set up beforehand; it is the browser that sends the request
